item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 03/Dec/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The band of clouds covering Guangdong will thin out gradually tomorrow. The weather will become fine over the region. Under the persistent influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be generally fine and dry over southern China in the latter part of this week to early next week. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over inland areas. Besides, the area of low pressure over the seas east of the Philippines is expected to develop gradually and move towards the central to southern parts of the Philippines in the next few days.
